instruction: Configure the VirtualBox provider with memory and CPUs
output: echo 'config.vm.provider "virtualbox" do |vb| vb.memory = 2048 vb.cpus = 2 end' >> Vagrantfile

instruction: Configure the VirtualBox provider with a custom name
output: echo 'config.vm.provider "virtualbox" do |vb| vb.name = "my-vm" end' >> Vagrantfile

instruction: Enable GUI mode in VirtualBox
output: echo 'config.vm.provider "virtualbox" do |vb| vb.gui = true end' >> Vagrantfile

instruction: Configure custom CPU exec cap in VirtualBox
output: echo 'config.vm.provider "virtualbox" do |vb| vb.customize ["modifyvm", :id, "--cpuexecutioncap", "50"] end' >> Vagrantfile

instruction: Add a second SATA controller via VirtualBox customize
output: echo 'config.vm.provider "virtualbox" do |vb| vb.customize ["storagectl", :id, "--name", "SATA", "--add", "sata"] end' >> Vagrantfile

instruction: Attach a second disk to VirtualBox VM
output: echo 'config.vm.provider "virtualbox" do |vb| vb.customize ["createhd", "--filename", "disk2.vdi", "--size", 10240] vb.customize ["storageattach", :id, "--storagectl", "SATA", "--port", 1, "--device", 0, "--type", "hdd", "--medium", "disk2.vdi"] end' >> Vagrantfile

instruction: Configure the VMware provider in Vagrant
output: echo 'config.vm.provider "vmware_desktop" do |vm| vm.memory = 2048 vm.cpus = 2 end' >> Vagrantfile

instruction: Configure the Hyper-V provider in Vagrant
output: echo 'config.vm.provider "hyperv" do |h| h.memory = 2048 h.cpus = 2 end' >> Vagrantfile

instruction: Enable nested virtualization in Hyper-V
output: echo 'config.vm.provider "hyperv" do |h| h.enable_virtualization_extensions = true end' >> Vagrantfile

instruction: Configure the Libvirt provider in Vagrant
output: echo 'config.vm.provider "libvirt" do |lv| lv.memory = 2048 lv.cpus = 2 end' >> Vagrantfile

instruction: Set Libvirt storage pool and volume name
output: echo 'config.vm.provider "libvirt" do |lv| lv.storage_pool_name = "default" lv.volume_name = "myvm.qcow2" end' >> Vagrantfile

instruction: Configure a Libvirt network with NAT
output: echo 'config.vm.provider "libvirt" do |lv| lv.management_network_name = "vagrant-net" lv.management_network_address = "192.168.122.0/24" end' >> Vagrantfile

instruction: Pass through a USB device in VirtualBox
output: echo 'config.vm.provider "virtualbox" do |vb| vb.customize ["usbfilter", "add", "0", "--target", :id, "--name", "MyUSB", "--vendorid", "0x1234"] end' >> Vagrantfile

instruction: Enable I/O APIC in VirtualBox guest
output: echo 'config.vm.provider "virtualbox" do |vb| vb.customize ["modifyvm", :id, "--ioapic", "on"] end' >> Vagrantfile

instruction: Set a custom MAC address for the NIC
output: echo 'config.vm.provider "virtualbox" do |vb| vb.customize ["modifyvm", :id, "--macaddress1", "080027ABCDEF"] end' >> Vagrantfile

instruction: Use a shell script as a Vagrant provisioner
output: echo 'config.vm.provision "shell", path: "scripts/setup.sh"' >> Vagrantfile

instruction: Use an inline shell command as provisioner
output: echo 'config.vm.provision "shell", inline: "sudo apt install -y nginx"' >> Vagrantfile

instruction: Use a privileged flag on shell provisioner
output: echo 'config.vm.provision "shell", inline: "apt update", privileged: true' >> Vagrantfile

instruction: Pass environment variables to shell provisioner
output: echo 'config.vm.provision "shell", env: {"ENV": "production"}, inline: "echo $ENV"' >> Vagrantfile

instruction: Keep the shell script environment after provisioning
output: echo 'config.vm.provision "shell", inline: "export APP_VERSION=1.0", keep_color: true' >> Vagrantfile

instruction: Set the upload path for shell provisioner scripts
output: echo 'config.vm.provision "shell", upload_path: "/tmp/setup.sh", path: "setup.sh"' >> Vagrantfile

instruction: Use a shell provisioner with arguments
output: echo 'config.vm.provision "shell", path: "install.sh", args: ["nginx", "1.24.0"]' >> Vagrantfile

instruction: Reboot VM during provisioning with shell script
output: echo 'config.vm.provision "shell", inline: "sudo reboot", reboot: true' >> Vagrantfile

instruction: Use the Ansible provisioner in Vagrant
output: echo 'config.vm.provision "ansible" do |ansible| ansible.playbook = "playbook.yml" end' >> Vagrantfile

instruction: Use ansible-local provisioner (runs inside VM)
output: echo 'config.vm.provision "ansible_local" do |ansible| ansible.playbook = "playbook.yml" end' >> Vagrantfile
